name: Hover card
summary: A preview of what a link points at, shown after a short delay on hover or keyboard focus.
description:
Use a hover card to preview a person, a repository or a product behind a link without leaving the page. It is a convenience: everything in it must also be on the page the link opens.

The card is a .v-popover.v-hovercard with popover="manual", so it never closes a menu or another popover. data-v-hovercard on the link opens it after half a second on hover, or a moment after keyboard focus, keeps it open while the pointer moves onto it, and closes it on leave, blur or Escape. Several links can share one card. On touch nothing extra happens: a tap follows the link.

classes.name: v-hovercard
classes.description: On a .v-popover with popover="manual": the card.

classes.name: v-hovercard-head
classes.description: An avatar or logo beside the title and subtitle.

classes.name: v-hovercard-title
classes.description: The name of the thing previewed.

classes.name: v-hovercard-sub
classes.description: A role, description or path under the title.

classes.name: v-hovercard-meta
classes.description: A row of small facts, on a <ul role="list">; <strong> inside stands out.

states.description: On the card. Manual, so opening it leaves other popovers alone and it only closes when the JS says.

hooks.name: data-v-hovercard
hooks.description: Opens the card beside the link after a delay on hover or focus and closes it on leave, blur or Escape.

keyboard.action: Focusing the link opens the card after a moment; moving on closes it.
Closes the card; focus stays on the link.

a11y: Meets WCAG 1.4.13: the card can be dismissed with Escape, the pointer can move onto it, and it stays until the pointer or focus leaves.
Keep it informational. A Follow or Buy button inside would be hard to reach by keyboard and invisible on touch; put actions on the linked page.
The link must make sense on its own: screen reader users get the link, not the preview.

examples.description: Rest the pointer on a link, or Tab to it. Two links share the person card.
